brand_identity.name: DrepanHope Foundation
brand_identity.mission: Empowering lives affected by Sickle Cell Disease through awareness, testing, and support.
brand_identity.design_philosophy: E1 Anti-AI: Fusion of Medical Precision + Human Warmth. No generic 'corporate charity' vibes.

headings.usage: All section titles, hero statements, and impact numbers. Adds a 'storytelling' and 'editorial' quality.

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI elements, buttons, navigation. Clean, legible, and modern.

mono.usage: Transparency data, financial reports, audit logs.

primary.name: Deep Navy
primary.usage: Footer, Hero Backgrounds, Primary Text, Strong Borders

secondary.name: Hope Teal
secondary.usage: Primary Buttons, Highlights, Progress Bars, Icons

accent.name: Life Coral
accent.usage: Urgent 'Donate' CTAs, Heart Icons, Error States

background.name: Soft Neutral
background.usage: Main Page Backgrounds (Avoids stark white sterility)

spacing.base: Generous. Use p-8 to p-16 for sections.

grids.bento_impact: Use 'Tetris' grid for Impact Stories. Mix tall images with square data cards.
grids.dashboard: Use 'Control Room' grid for Admin Panel. Dense, data-focused.

containers.cards: Rounded-xl or Rounded-2xl. No sharp edges for donor-facing pages.
containers.sections: Alternate between Soft Neutral (bg-slate-50) and White (bg-white) to create rhythm.

buttons.primary: Rounded-full. bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-700 text-white font-semibold shadow-lg hover:shadow-teal-500/30 transition-all
buttons.donate: Rounded-full. bg-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-600 text-white font-bold shadow-xl hover:shadow-rose-500/40 hover:scale-105 transition-all uppercase tracking-wide
buttons.outline: Rounded-full. border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-teal-600 hover:text-teal-600 transition-colors

cards.donation_card: Glassmorphism effect on Hero. White bg with 'Tracing Beam' border on Donate page.
cards.campaign_card: Image top (h-64), content bottom. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-xl.

inputs.style: Shadcn Input. Rounded-lg. Border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 focus:border-transparent bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-sm

navigation.style: Sticky glassmorphism header. Logo left, Nav center, Donate/Lang right.
navigation.mobile: Sheet component from Shadcn for hamburger menu.

textures.noise: Add a subtle SVG noise overlay to the Deep Navy sections to prevent 'flatness'.
textures.blobs: Use large, blurred Teal/Blue orbs in the background of the Hero section.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px. Rounded joins. Color: Teal-600 or Slate-700.

motion.entrance: Framer Motion: Fade Up (opacity 0 -> 1, y 20 -> 0) with staggerChildren for lists.

hero.alt: Happy African American child smiling, representing hope
hero.treatment: Full width or split screen. Overlay gradient for text readability.

community.alt: Diverse group of people supporting the cause

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Navy text on Slate-50 meets AA standards. White text on Teal-600 is borderline - use Teal-700 for text or bold weight.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-teal-500) on all interactive elements.
accessibility.i18n: Design must accommodate French text expansion (approx 1.3x length of English). Avoid fixed-width buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent.2: Setup the Tailwind config to include the custom colors (Deep Navy, Hope Teal, Life Coral).
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Create a 'Layout' component that handles the Sticky Header and Footer.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Implement the 'LanguageSwitcher' early - it affects layout spacing.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Use 'Shadcn' components for the Admin Dashboard but style them to match the 'Deep Navy' brand (custom theme).
instructions_to_main_agent.6: For the 'Donate' page, build a custom 'DonationAmountSelector' component that feels tactile (big buttons, clear selection state).
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Ensure all images use the provided Pexels URLs.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Do not use generic 'Lorem Ipsum'. Use realistic copy related to Sickle Cell and DrepanHope.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
